faqs.question: How long does a typical AI Search Optimization engagement take?
faqs.answer: Foundational AEO/GEO work usually takes 6–12 weeks, then ongoing content and entity optimization compounds visibility over subsequent quarters.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We collaborate with SEO, content, and engineering teams and extend your CMS, analytics, and schema tooling rather than forcing a rip-and-replace.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: We track branded and unbranded visibility in AI answers, citation share, organic conversions, entity coverage, and search demand for priority topics.

faqs.question: How is this different from traditional SEO?
faqs.answer: Classic SEO optimizes rankings and clicks. AI Search Optimization also structures entities, evidence, and answer-ready content so AI systems can cite you accurately.

faqs.question: Do we still need SEO if we invest in AEO?
faqs.answer: Yes. Technical health, crawlability, and authoritative pages remain the foundation. AEO builds on SEO — it does not replace it.

faqs.question: What content changes should we expect?
faqs.answer: Clearer answer blocks, FAQs, comparisons, schema, internal linking, and evidence pages that make your expertise easy for both humans and AI systems to trust.

faqs.question: Will this help local or B2B brands?
faqs.answer: Both. Local entities, service areas, and B2B product/category authority each get tailored entity and content playbooks.

faqs.question: How quickly can we see results?
faqs.answer: Technical and content foundations show signal in weeks; durable citation and demand gains usually build over 1–2 quarters of consistent publishing.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: We audit your current search footprint, competitors, and entity gaps, then prioritize a 90-day roadmap tied to revenue topics.

faqs.question: Who owns the workstreams?
faqs.answer: A search strategist leads; content and engineering support schema, page templates, and measurement instrumentation.
